unit: a lot footprint, shown with the hatching model's district (`code`); the old pattern reader's read in `reader_code`

model.what: 1921 lots ranked by the hatching model's probability that the pattern reader's read is wrong, spread over the blocks in rounds (round k: each block's k-th most likely wrong footprint, by that probability); one case per footprint (condo lots stacked on one outline share it, `blklots`); each lot's least confident read, as the label-check page; the owner's answered lots left out.

design.order: the file's rank (rounds over the blocks by the chance the old read is wrong)
